name: How long does a typical window replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical window replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window replacement project depends on the number of windows, their size, the type of installation (full-frame or insert), and any unexpected structural issues. For an average-sized home with 10-15 windows, installation can typically be completed within one to three days. Larger projects or those requiring significant frame repair might take longer. Your contractor will provide a more accurate timeline after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: An average window replacement for 10-15 windows typically takes one to three days, depending on project scope and complexity.
